rules: G1 Wire: 56 takes no params and answers mana_free_time, crystal_free_time, mana_free_num, main_ids (2 SX), second_ids (3 SX), mana_id, partner_id, pet_id and directional_show_id only when a magic target exists. 50 takes summon_type (required) and summon_index (absent = 1) and answers result[] (hero rows: stock hero projection plus is_partner true; duplicate rows: table_id stone, item_num, to_stone true; item rows: table_id, item_num), reward only on the tutorial Small pull, summon_info and economy_.

G2 Refusals: unknown button is HTTP 400; refused admission (timer, count, balance, hero capacity, unported family) is HTTP 200 {error_code 1, result []}; anything else 503 summon_unavailable. No partial pull is ever committed.
G3 Exactly once: one operation receipt per pull (domain summon, gxb.summon.pull.v1); the draw stream is derived from the operation, so a retry or unknown COMMIT replays the stored rows (D144, D145).
G4 Lock order: actor fence, HeroRoot 400 (LockStoryRosterTx), summon_players row, I5 rows, open objectives. Loads (56, MID1 overlay) take no lock and never create the state row.
G5 Duplicates: an owned origin, or one gained earlier in the same pull, becomes stone_id fragments 7/14/30 by initial star (D116, D141).

G6 Tutorial: the first Small pull is Lavia 10001002 plus summon_reward 50001002 x10, the first Medium free pull is Pandaria 10001003 (summon.lua summon_special milestones); Aquaris 10001001 is granted at birth (D139). The client guide 100102 to 100116 runs unchanged (I9-TUTORIAL-ALWAYS-ON).
G7 Featured: Medium featured overlay and its 56-girl cohort plus 58-girl extension, SX main ids per 7-day block and second ids per day are a fixed-seed calendar on modes.Day GMT+8 (D142).

G8 Operator hook: summon_tuning.payload (versioned JSON) overlays rates, pity, extension weight, machine cohorts and pinned featured/main/second ids. Catalog.Tune validates it; an invalid overlay is logged and the source policy is served. Pool row weights inside dropbox pools are not tunable (shortcut, I11).

G9 Facts: every committed pull records one SUMMON objective fact with Delta = slots pulled in the settling transaction (task_req 17, I9-MISSION-SUMMON-FACT). Partner 18 (specific girl owned) is high-water from player_heroes.

G10 Surface: 50 and 56 ACTIVE (I9-3E); 70, 71, 305, 306 ACTIVE at I9-3F; the 21 event-gacha MIDs stay LATER with their seasonal events (D138) and must reuse internal/domain/summon draw rules and this receipt pattern when they land.

G11 Premium (I9-3F): 50 type 4 is SX (388 crystal, VIP >= 9 from the I5 privilege snapshot else refused, summon_index 1|2 selects main_ids hotspot, 6 rows: one item from each pool 200007..200011 plus a dynamic slot by class weight, hotspot pity 25). 70 {summon_time 1|10, partner_id} needs the stored, owned Magic target and answers result rows plus stick_items [{item_id,item_num}] of the target's stone; 71 {partner_id} stores an owned Magic list target and answers {partner_id}; 305 {table_id} creates the Vows hero through characterhero.CreateVows (prerequisites, one 5-star, level gate, production collection admission); 306 {table_id,times} debits essence 50001666 x super_scroll_cost x times and answers {awards:[{table_id: scroll, item_num: times}]}. SX class weights, hotspot share and pity are operator tunable (G8).
